name: AbyM Consent Banner for Digital Anumati
author: digitalanumati

sections.description:
AbyM Consent Banner for Digital Anumati helps site administrators add the Digital Anumati consent banner scripts to a WordPress site.

After activation, go to Settings > Digital Anumati and add the head/body scripts supplied by Digital Anumati. The plugin prints approved Digital Anumati script snippets in the document head or immediately after the opening body tag.

The plugin stores its settings in WordPress options, sanitizes the script fields to allow only script, noscript, and iframe markup needed by the service, and shows an admin notice until the integration has been configured.

External Services

This plugin can print script snippets supplied by Digital Anumati to display and manage the consent banner. Those snippets may load JavaScript from Digital Anumati, including:

  • Service URL: https://consent.digitalanumati.com/anumati-dpdp-consent-v1.js
  • Service website: https://www.digitalanumati.com/

When configured with the Digital Anumati script snippets, the visitor’s browser may request this JavaScript file from Digital Anumati. The request may include normal browser request information such as IP address, user agent, referrer, and any data handled by the Digital Anumati script according to that service’s policies.

Site administrators should review the Digital Anumati terms and privacy policy before enabling the integration.

External services

This plugin connects to the Digital Anumati Consent Service (https://consent.digitalanumati.com) to display and manage the DPDP consent banner.
It loads JavaScript from consent.digitalanumati.com when the frontend is visited and a Site Key is configured.
Data that may be transmitted includes website domain, browser/device information, IP address and consent preferences.
Terms of Service: https://digitalanumati.com/term-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://digitalanumati.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/abym-consent-banner-digital-anumati/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Digital Anumati.
  4. Paste the head/body script snippets supplied by Digital Anumati.
  5. Save the settings and check the front end of the site to confirm the banner appears.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Digital Anumati account?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to scripts and identifiers supplied by Digital Anumati.

Where do I configure the banner?

Open Settings > Digital Anumati in the WordPress admin area.
